title: runner → studio: a run's lifecycle
description: Subject evt.run.<session_id>.status (stream EVT), Nats-Msg-Id <run_id>:<attempt>:<seq>. `running` once when the runner starts the graph (with host), then exactly one terminal status. The runner publishes the terminal status and waits for its ack before it acks the command.

error.description: a short, user-readable reason; required (non-empty) when failed

host.description: the host running it (sent with running)

resolved.description: sent with succeeded: values the runner chose for the run (a random seed, an auto length), so the UI shows what was actually used; open for more fields

params.description: `<node>.<param>` -> the value the runner chose for a param the run set to "auto" (a frames param: the predicted length, on its grid). Studio records it in made_with.inputs (made_with.typed keeps "auto")

attempt.description: the attempt of cmd.run.execute this event belongs to; absent = 1. seq restarts at 1 for each attempt; the projector dedupes on (job_id, attempt, seq) and drops events of an attempt that is not the run's current one

answer.description: from API 1.14, a run of a text (ask) workflow: sent with succeeded (required then) and with failed when the answers did not match the schema; studio stores it as Run.answer and copies it into evt.studio.run_finished
